title: Catalog fold hashes raw JSON comment bytes, so a docs-only data edit re-blesses every golden
detail: The fold's own comment says 'sim-relevant' bytes, but _comment docs are folded too. Since catalog_hash rides every tick hash, any comment tweak churns all 35 .t1 files (~21.4k insertions/20.8k deletions, 72 files this PR) with zero behavioral signal — this PR paid it twice (250679b1→17d3baf8 'comment-accuracy fold').
recommended_fix: Fold canonical value bytes (strip `_comment`/`_*` keys before hashing, or hash a re-serialized form) so documentation edits stop forcing full golden re-blesses; keep the header catalog_hash binding and drift rejection unchanged.
